basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: GTM Engineer & AI Systems Builder | Ships Internal AI Workflows for Sales/RevOps | 3× Founder | MBA
basics.summary: GTM Engineer by practice: I build the internal AI-powered tools GTM teams use. At LumApps I own the production multi-agent outbound system on TypeScript, Python, LangGraph and Google ADK. Unified Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo and product usage into one time-aware store (AI Brain), shipped agents that Sales, RevOps and CS actually use, and instrumented every workflow with evals, tracing and adoption metrics. Result: 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast quarterly. Prior GTM launches co-owned at Beekeeper (Employee Referral $1.5M+ revenue, GenAI demo tooling for sales), 3 AI products founded solo. MBA, 4 conference talks, bias to ship trustworthy systems fast.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Built the AI-powered internal system Sales and RevOps use daily. Multi-agent workflows on Python, TypeScript, LangGraph, Google ADK, MCP and AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti/Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, product usage) into one auditable time-aware store. Data quality, schema governance, and API design so GTM teams can actually trust the data.

Own the reliability layer: eval pipelines, LangSmith tracing, cost-per-request instrumentation, HITL checkpoints, and adoption metrics. Partner with Sales, RevOps, and Ops on rollout; report to C-level on GTM outcomes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.position: Senior Software Engineer (Technical Lead) & GTM Co-Owner
highlights: Co-owned cross-functional GTM launches with Sales, PM, and RevOps: Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis, Employee Lifecycle. Every launch instrumented so we knew within a week if it moved pipeline.
Built GenAI demo tooling that auto-composed personalized, on-brand demo content per account from Salesforce data. Direct sales enablement impact: improved demo speed and close rates.

Architected Employee Referral System end to end (TypeScript, Vue, Node.js, Java, PostgreSQL). Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR. Enterprise deal execution and post-launch expansion.
Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. Turned an operational blocker into a durable internal tool, transitioned ownership to product team.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups for seed-to-VC decisions on architecture, scalability, and GTM readiness.
Advised portfolio companies on production AI adoption for GTM: prompt design, evals, and instrumentation to prove pipeline impact.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Founding engineer at a startup. Full-stack (Vue, Node.js, Java, PostgreSQL, real-time APIs, AWS/Docker/Terraform) from empty repo to 500+ real-world deliveries.
Turned prototype demos into enterprise partnerships (Unilever) and a CES showcase. Same discipline as internal GTM tools: ambiguous problem to shipped system fast.
